record.question: Immediate disinfection of all articles and bodily discharge during the course of disease is known as:
record.explanation: Answer A: Concurrent disinfection. Concurrent disinfection is performed during the course of an infectious disease, including disinfection of articles and discharges as they occur. Reference: https://www.cdc.gov/infection-control/hcp/disinfection-sterilization/index.html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
